# `Q-2-20` — Unclosed Editorial Delete

> An editorial-delete span opens with `[--` but no closing `]`
> appears before the end of the block.

## What this means

The editorial-delete form `[--struck-out text]` is part of
Quarto's tracked-change markup family. This error fires when the
opener `[--` appears without a matching `]`.

## Why this happens

A deleted closing bracket, or a literal `[--` in text that the
parser took as an editorial opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `]`. If the bracketed text was not meant as an
editorial mark, escape the bracket: `\[--text]`.

## Example

```markdown
[--
```
